Citrine 3.1.1 verifies the signature on NIP-42 AUTH events. Earlier versions did not.

The Android relay checked a kind 22242 event's challenge, relay tag and timestamp, then trusted the pubkey in it. A client could claim any pubkey and pass the gate on kind 4 DMs, kind 1059 gift wraps and kind 30078 app data. Default installs listen on 127.0.0.1 only, so the reach was the same device unless the listen address was changed.

The release, published 11 September, also scopes subscription ids per connection, gives COUNT a single aggregated answer, fixes a #p key that refused authenticated users, and applies the NIP-01 lowest-id tie-break to replaceable events. Citrine 3.2.0 contains all of it.
